# Greenhouse Jobs Scraper & API - All Companies, Last 24 Hours

> Greenhouse jobs scraper and API for every company on boards.greenhouse.io, searched live by job title, location, remote, job type and posting date, newest first.

## Summary

Greenhouse Jobs Search is an Apify actor that searches every company's job board on Greenhouse (boards.greenhouse.io and job-boards.greenhouse.io) at once and returns one row per job, newest first: title, company, location, remote or onsite, job type, pay, first-published date, deadline and link. It covers 8,357 job boards of 8,317 companies, which held 216,033 open jobs at 7,201 companies on 2026-11-02, at employers such as SpaceX, Anduril, Databricks, Stripe, Anthropic, Cloudflare, Datadog and GitLab. It reads Greenhouse's public Job Board API live at run time, with no login and no API key. 22% of the jobs publish pay, and the pay comes with every row.

Store: https://apify.com/anshumanatrey/greenhouse-jobs-search
Source: https://github.com/AnshumanAtrey/greenhouse-jobs-search

## Key features

- All 8,357 job boards on the list at once, with no company names needed, read live rather than from a stored copy (at most about 85% of hiring boards; others by name or link).
- Pay on the plain row when the company publishes it: every pay zone, in each currency, with no period, because Greenhouse stores none.
- One keyword is enough; an empty form returns the newest jobs of every kind.
- Newest first by the date the company first published the job: an edit to an old job does not make it new.
- Place filter by city, state, country or region: London, Germany, EMEA, LatAm, Worldwide. Locations are free text, so US jobs written as City, ST are found by the city or the state code (TX).
- Reads a pasted Google dork such as site:boards.greenhouse.io intext:engineer.
- Job link check: each pasted link, including the career pages of companies on the list with ?gh_jid=, comes back open, closed or not found.

## Input keys

- Job titles to find (searchTerms): one per line; a job matches when its title has every word.
- Where the job is (location): city, state, country or region.
- Remote or onsite (workType): remote, hybrid or onsite, from the company's own job fields, else from Remote, Hybrid or On-site in the location, or Remote or Hybrid in the title.
- Posted in the last (postedWithin): 24 hours, 3 days, 7 days, 30 days, any time, or your own period.
- Number of jobs (maxJobs): 100 by default, 0 for every match.
- Full details (includeDetails): adds the description, the department, the reference number and pay as numbers with its currency.
- Leave out words (excludeTerms): drops jobs whose title has these words.
- Job type (employmentType): full-time, part-time, contract, intern or temporary, where the company states it.
- Match descriptions (searchDescriptions): finds your words in the description too.
- Only these companies (companies): a name, the name in the address, or a Greenhouse link.
- Job links to check (jobUrls): checks links instead of searching.

## Pricing

PAY_PER_EVENT model, platform usage included:

- Job: $0.0018 per saved job ($1.80 per 1,000), and per checked link that is closed or not found
- Job with details: $0.0019 per saved job with full details on ($1.90 per 1,000)
- Run start: $0.01 per GB of memory, charged by Apify when a run starts, so $0.01 at the default 1 GB

On paid Apify plans the job prices are 10% less on Scale ($0.00162 and $0.00171) and 20% less on Business and above ($0.00144 and $0.00152); the run start stays $0.01 per GB.

Typical costs (Free and Starter price, default memory):

- 100 newest jobs: $0.19
- 100 jobs with full details: $0.20
- 1,000 jobs: $1.81
- Every job on the list, 216,033 on 2026-11-02: $388.87

Greenhouse has no search, so every search reads all 8,357 job boards whatever it finds; the run start pays for that read. Apify's free $5 monthly credit covers about 2,600 jobs in runs of 100.

## Speed

About 3 minutes at the default 1 GB for a search of every board: 185 s for software engineer and 216 s for the empty form on Apify on 2026-11-03. At 2 GB the same search took 119 s, with a $0.02 run start. Naming companies or checking links reads only those boards.

## How to call it

- Apify API: POST https://api.apify.com/v2/acts/anshumanatrey~greenhouse-jobs-search/run-sync-get-dataset-items with the input as JSON and the header Authorization: Bearer <APIFY_TOKEN>. It returns the rows and waits up to 300 seconds, so start bigger runs (every job, a description search) with a client.
- Python and JavaScript: the apify-client package, actor anshumanatrey/greenhouse-jobs-search.
- n8n: the Apify node, Run an Actor and get dataset. Make: the Apify app's Run an Actor and Get Dataset Items modules.
- MCP: https://mcp.apify.com?tools=anshumanatrey/greenhouse-jobs-search, signed in with Apify or with Authorization: Bearer <APIFY_TOKEN>.

## When to use

- The user wants jobs from companies on Greenhouse, or a Greenhouse jobs API or job board API.
- The user wants a daily feed of new jobs by title, country or region across every company on Greenhouse.
- The user wants jobs with published pay at tech companies.
- The user wants every open job of one company that hires through Greenhouse, such as Anthropic or GitLab.
- The user wants to check whether Greenhouse job links are still open.

## When NOT to use

- The user needs the pay period: Greenhouse does not store one.
- The user needs a country filter that is complete for the United States: many US jobs give only a city and state.
- The user needs work type or job type on every job: Greenhouse has them only when a company states them, in its own fields or, for work type, in the location or title (about 1 job in 5).
- The user needs jobs from companies that are not on Greenhouse: use the sibling actor for that platform (Sibling actors below) or a multi-ATS actor.
- The user wants the lowest price for a few jobs per run: with the $0.01 run start, runs under 50 jobs cost less at the $0.002-a-job actors with no start fee, such as fantastic-jobs/greenhouse-jobs-api and yugenox/ats-jobs-search.

## Sample input

```json
{
  "searchTerms": ["software engineer"],
  "location": ["London", "Germany"],
  "postedWithin": "7 days",
  "maxJobs": 100
}
```

## Sample output (one record)

From the example run of the deployed build (1.0.1) on 2026-11-03, run j96er5Rmn9tfQUkCt, searching every board for software engineer.

## Differentiators vs alternatives

- vs fantastic-jobs/greenhouse-jobs-api ($0.002 per job, $0.0012 on Scale and above, no start fee): AI fields and LinkedIn company data from a stored database; this actor costs less per job on the Free and Starter plans, so a run of more than 50 jobs costs less here (more than 100 with full details), and it reads Greenhouse live.
- vs yugenox/ats-jobs-search ($0.002 per job, no start fee): also live, and it covers Lever and Ashby too; this actor costs less for runs of more than 50 jobs and searches its 8,357 Greenhouse boards.
- vs bovi/greenhouse-lever-ashby-job-scraper ($0.0015 per job): cheaper per job, but it reads only the companies you name or its four curated preset lists; this actor searches all 8,357 boards on its list at once.

## Sibling actors

- Ashby Jobs Scraper (https://apify.com/anshumanatrey/ashby-jobs-search): Jobs from every company on Ashby (jobs.ashbyhq.com), searched live
- Cornerstone Jobs Scraper (https://apify.com/anshumanatrey/cornerstone-jobs-search): Jobs from every company on Cornerstone (csod.com), searched live
- Workday Jobs Scraper (https://apify.com/anshumanatrey/workday-job-search): Jobs from every company on Workday (myworkdayjobs.com), searched live
- Deel Jobs Scraper (https://apify.com/anshumanatrey/deel-jobs-search): Jobs from every company on Deel ATS (jobs.deel.com), with pay
- SmartRecruiters Jobs Scraper (https://apify.com/anshumanatrey/smartrecruiters-jobs-search): Jobs from 2,900+ companies on SmartRecruiters, searched live
- Workable Jobs Scraper (https://apify.com/anshumanatrey/workable-job-search): Jobs from every company on Workable, in one search
- Lever Jobs Scraper (https://apify.com/anshumanatrey/lever-jobs-search): Jobs from 2,300+ companies on Lever (jobs.lever.co), searched live
